[NAHHAS:v5p247/r4] NAHHAS, d. 338 · author | rejects | He rejects the Kufan rule of writing yāʾ-root words with yāʾ: spelling should reflect pronunciation, and if it followed root origin then words from wāw roots would need wāw; Qurʾānic and conventional forms expose the inconsistency.
[NAHHAS:v5p247/r5] NAHHAS, d. 338 · محمد بن يزيد | reports | He argues that spelling records spoken form just as speech conveys what is in the mind, and cites rāmā and ghazā against root-based spelling.
